name: API Studio
description: An HTTP client for building, sending and testing API requests. Collections are folders of plain files kept in Git, with environments and secrets that never reach those files. Requests have params, bodies, headers, auth (Basic, Bearer, API key, OAuth 2.0, Digest, NTLM, AWS Signature v4), scripts, checks and tests. Responses show pretty, as a tree or a preview, with headers, cookies, a timing waterfall and the test results. A runner runs collections with data rows; OpenAPI, Swagger, HAR and curl import; code in a dozen languages; and an assistant that explains failures and writes requests, tests and docs. Requests go out through the curl program, without a shell, their contents on its standard input.

commands.title: API Studio: open
commands.description: Open API Studio, on a saved request when one is named.

request.description: A request's name, "Folder / Name", or its file's path

commands.title: API Studio: new request
commands.description: Open a new request, with a method and URL when given.

commands.title: API Studio: what is open
commands.description: The open collections (their requests, environments and the one in use), the open tabs and their last statuses.

commands.title: API Studio: list a collection's requests
commands.description: Every request of a collection (the first open one unless named), with its folder, method and URL.

commands.title: API Studio: send a request
commands.description: Send a saved request by name (or a method, url, headers and body), with its environment, scripts, checks and tests; answers with the status, time, headers (secrets hidden), the body and the test results.

request.description: A request's name, "Folder / Name", or its file's path

commands.title: API Studio: run a collection
commands.description: Run a collection's requests in order (a folder's when named), as many iterations as asked, and answer with the totals and every failure.

commands.title: API Studio: import a curl command
commands.description: Open a curl command as a request.

commands.title: API Studio: ask the assistant
commands.description: Open the assistant, asking about the request in front when a question is given.

endue.api-studio.curl.description: The curl program requests go through: a path, or empty for curl on the desk's PATH (then where it is usually installed).

endue.api-studio.history.description: Keep the last requests sent in the History panel.
